entities.name: HIV-1 Env gp160
observations: The 768-aa query sequence matches reviewed HIV-1 group M subtype B Env gp160 (UniProt P35961) at 83.6% identity and 100% query coverage; sequence includes ambiguous X residues.
Env gp160 is processed in the trans-Golgi by furin-like proteases into gp120 and gp41; the mature complex is a trimer of heterodimers.
gp120 mediates attachment to CD4 and coreceptor CCR5 and/or CXCR4; gp41 mediates class I viral and host membrane fusion.
Annotated locations include the virion envelope/membrane and host cell/endosome membranes; Env traffics through ER and Golgi.
Associated processes include virion attachment, viral protein processing, clathrin-dependent endocytosis, and fusion with host endosomal or plasma membranes.
